_:
Leading executables observed in recorded Bash invocations of rite-driven agent runs (v0.5.1 acceptance runs, permission probes, and this project's development sessions). Committed so the default allowlist can be checked against evidence rather than against imagination.
Rule: heredoc bodies stripped; an entry is included only if it led a WHOLE Bash command at least once (which removes prose that merely parsed like a command), and resolves as a real executable on the recording machine. The count is every time it led a command or a segment of one.
